## Composition

8 document types (54 docs): CAPITAL_CALL ×10, QUARTERLY_REPORT ×10, DISTRIBUTION ×8,
CAPITAL_ACCOUNT_STATEMENT ×6, ANNUAL_REPORT ×5, FINANCIAL_STATEMENT ×5,
INVESTOR_UPDATE ×5, TERM_SHEET ×5. Each document carries a `format` tag (standard /
table-heavy / narrative / scanned / legacy).

## Provenance & honesty

- **Ground-truth field values** are modeled on the repository's golden fixtures
  (`tests/eval/fixtures/golden-documents.ts`) and the production extraction schemas
  (`src/lib/documents/schemas/*.ts`) — real field names, types and required/optional flags.
- **Predictions** come from a documented extraction simulator whose per-field error
  rates encode the pipeline's documented behaviour (Document AI → tables/forms; LLM →
  narrative; hybrid → merge precedence from `merge.ts:233-253`) and the per-type
  confidence thresholds in `router.ts`. They are **not** live GCP extractions.
- **To use production data:** replace `predictions_*.jsonl` with the pipeline's
  `DocumentExtraction` output (same JSONL shape: `docId`, `predDocType`,
  `docTypeConfidence`, and one key per extracted field) and re-run the deliverable
  scripts — all metric code is identical.

## Schema (one record)

```json
// ground_truth.jsonl
{"docId": "doc-000-capital_call", "docType": "CAPITAL_CALL", "_meta": {"format": "legacy"},
 "fundName": "...", "totalAmount": 27000000.0, "dueDate": "2024-03-15", ...}

// predictions_hybrid.jsonl
{"docId": "doc-000-capital_call", "docType": "CAPITAL_CALL", "predDocType": "CAPITAL_CALL",
 "docTypeConfidence": 0.865, "fundName": "...", "totalAmount": "USD 27,000,000", ...}
```
